plan.title: Recreate Order offered on upcoming RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared upcoming RFQ's project summary as required for prepared-state cases.
Enable the eRFX project capability required for the upcoming RFQ setup.
Verify Recreate Order is present and clickable in the RFQ Settings menu.
Select Recreate Order to open its window without confirming any changes.
Confirm that selecting Recreate Order opened a dialog or window.
Cancel the Recreate Order window so the event remains unchanged.
Confirm the Recreate Order window closed after cancellation.
